interfaces.header: 128bytes:10u64 ticket/original occurrence/support/generation/four payload refs/revision/flags;6f64 original start/end/deadline/first receipt/update/source availability. Payload objects are not stored here.
interfaces.identity: Nonreused epoch-qualified queue tickets. Producer must separately allocate nonreused original occurrence/support IDs and generation-qualified immutable payload refs. Pending aliases share ticket; conflicting original support/descriptor/lineage rejected.
interfaces.indexes: Fixed min-heap ordered(end,start,occurrence ID), free stack and two open-address indexes. Tombstones are reusable; scans bounded by table length and counted, including collisions/churn.
interfaces.revision: Only activity/joint payload refs, revision and availability can change before the original deadline. Old revision does not overwrite; conflicting same revision rejected. Replaced refs are returned for explicit release. Original aliases do not overwrite revised payloads.
interfaces.claim: Oldest due header becomes immutable, with original deadline and actual first claim delivery separate. One active ticket holds its slot until explicit consumer commit/loss acknowledgment. Repeated take returns the same frozen claim.
interfaces.release: Foreign epoch/stale ticket cannot release current active slot. Successful consumer acknowledgment increments committed sequence; failed acknowledgment is unsealed computational loss without a sequence gap. The queue cannot verify an external assertion that the consumer actually committed.
interfaces.loss: Capacity loss never evicts an admitted pending/active endpoint. Seal cut rejects late/replayed old endings after release. Producer identity nonreuse remains required beyond the retained horizon.
interfaces.budget: At most10240 distinct claimed endpoints per supplied processing cycle; carried active claim counts in a new cycle. Excess remains queued. New cycle IDs require increasing observation cut, but actual runtime must supply genuine cycle boundaries and enforce producer admission bursts.
